properties.description: The two walks that follow a reasoning chain step by step, foundations_walk (what a concluded node rests on, served on get_node and design_foundations) and proof_chain_walk (the steps under a proof, read by get_node, loop_status, detect_gaps and reasoning_report), keep an explicit work stack instead of recursing once per step, so a chain of any depth is walked in the same small stack and every answer is the one the recursion gave. The server's runtime is built by reflow2_mcp::runtime::server_runtime with SERVER_THREAD_STACK (16 MiB) for every mode, as headroom for the recursion that remains and is bounded (the truth evaluation at 64 steps, which needs 4 to 6 MiB on a debug build).
properties.name: A reasoning chain of any depth is walked in a fixed stack, and the server's threads have a stack somebody chose
